regions.today: Bright and breezy for the rest of today with sunny spells. Largely dry with isolated showers dying out. Moderate to fresh and gusty southwest to west winds will ease also.
regions.tonight: Dry tonight with a mix of cloud and clear spells. Lowest temperatures of 7 to 11 degrees, with light to moderate southwest to west winds, easing further overnight.
regions.tomorrow: Some bright or sunny spells at first on Sunday, but cloud will build from the southwest through the day. Most parts will stay dry but the odd spot of drizzle is possible during the late afternoon and evening. Highest temperatures of 15 to 18 degrees, with light westerly or variable breezes becoming southerly.
regions.solar_uv: Mostly moderate on Sunday. Low to moderate on Monday.
